newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Solana welcomes Spain's NATO vote.
newsitem.headline: Solana welcomes Spain's NATO vote.

text.p: NATO Secretary General Javier Solana on Thursday welcomed Spain's decision to participate fully in NATO's military structure, saying the decision was a timely one.

"The alliance and its structures have already been greatly changed to take account of the dramatic developments in European security in the last few years," the former Spanish foreign minister said in a statement.
"Spain's participation in the new structure will enable her to play her full part in reshaping the alliance to meet the challenges of tommorrow," Solana said.
The Spanish parliament on Thursday approved the country's full integration into NATO's military command.
Madrid joined NATO in 1982 but stayed out of the military structure pending a referendum. The 1986 referendum passed with 52 percent of voters saying "yes".
